_meta._note: Chapter 72, Lesson 8 (ch72-l07 converted in place to CL18, the final integrated conversation; the old 'emotional climax' STANDARD content is dropped, not moved). One visit to an Arabic learning centre in three linked scenes — reception, the lesson, the book desk — with A the member of staff in each scene and B the learner. Three goals and six PICK mission turns, two per scene, the schema's limits. The eight functions (greeting, name and origin, location, start time, a learning question, a help request, a price and a purchase, a polite close) each have their own earlier-chapter home — Chapters 3, 12, 5, 31, 31, 50, 61 and the Chapter 31/40 closing — and each has its own practice decision in the ten exercises (Maryam's name, the office, and the book facts are fresh), so the short mission does not stand in for them. Every learner line is an existing phrase of an earlier lab; the new combinations are أَيْنَ الْفَصْلُ؟ and مَتَى يَبْدَأُ الدَّرْسُ؟ (known patterns with new nouns). The timetable (lesson at four, ten riyals each) is invented. Twenty-three phrase clips are listed in Docs/lesson-audio-needed.md; none is generated. No pronunciation is graded; shadowing is optional. This lab is separate from Chapter 70's SP11 and is not scored by the Chapter 72 test. Added 2026-10-04 in the proposal harvest, batch 10 (Docs/proposals/proposal-harvest-tracker.md), from Docs/proposals/chapter-72-content-proposal.md and its review amendments.

scene.en: One visit to an Arabic learning centre. You (B) are the learner. A is the member of staff in each scene: the receptionist first, then your teacher, then the bookseller at the book desk. title.en: A Visit to a Learning Centre

mission.en: Move through one visit to an Arabic learning centre. At reception greet, give your name and country, and ask where the classroom is and when the lesson begins. In the lesson ask what a word means and say you have lost your bag. At the book desk ask a price, say how many you want, and close politely.
mission.ur: عربی سیکھنے کے ایک مرکز کے ایک دورے سے گزریں۔ استقبالیہ پر سلام کریں، اپنا نام اور ملک بتائیں، اور پوچھیں کہ کمرۂ جماعت کہاں ہے اور سبق کب شروع ہوتا ہے۔ سبق میں پوچھیں کہ لفظ کا مطلب کیا ہے اور بتائیں کہ آپ کی تھیلی کھو گئی ہے۔ کتابوں کی میز پر قیمت پوچھیں، بتائیں کہ کتنی چاہئیں، اور شائستگی سے بات ختم کریں۔
